descriptionChirho: The proper name Asaph (אָסָף, 'gatherer'), referring primarily to: (1) the Levitical musician appointed by David, ancestor of a major guild of temple singers and credited with multiple psalms (1 Chr 6:39, 15:17, 16:5–7; 2 Chr 5:12, 29:30; Ps 50, 73–83 superscriptions), (2) the keeper of the king's forest under Artaxerxes (Neh 2:8), and (3) a Levitical ancestor (1 Chr 26:1). The three clusters represent the bare name and conjunction-prefixed forms (31x), preposition-prefixed לְאָסָף 'of Asaph' used in psalm superscriptions (12x), and another prepositional usage 'to/for Asaph' (3x). All are the same referential name: spa Asaf, hin आसाप, arb آسَافَ, kor 아삽, swa Asafu.
